assessments.name: Final Exam
assessments.description: Paper-based exam, 2-hours, closed book. General formulas will be provided.

assessments.name: In class engagement
assessments.description: Engagement with course content quantified with weekly online quizzes. Quizzes are 0.5% each and are intended to probe retention and synthesis of course material and to probe depth of tutorial participation.

assessments.name: Course and tutorial attendance
assessments.description: Attendance in lectures (in-person or online) and tutorials (in-person) is required. Online lecture attendance will be granted if the recording is watched on the same day as the lecture. Less than 80% attendance in EITHER lectures OR tutorials nets a 0%.
